items.claim: Handle empty carts in average(). average() is called with an empty list, e.g. a newly created cart.
items.consequence: average([]) raises an unhandled ZeroDivisionError, so the summary panel fails for every new cart, contrary to the PR's stated empty-cart case (the panel itself is not in this repository).
items.proposed_fix: In `pricing.py`, return 0.0 (or raise a documented ValueError that callers handle) when `prices` is empty; add a test for the empty list.
